scripts.test: pnpm run ensure:workspace && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.import:users: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec ts-node prisma/import-users.ts
scripts.import:students: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec ts-node prisma/import-students.ts
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:reset: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: bash scripts/with-host-database-url.sh pnpm --filter @dms/database exec prisma db seed
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @dms/shared-auth --filter @dms/database --filter auth-service --filter academic-service --filter financial-service --filter api-gateway test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter auth-service --filter academic-service --filter financial-service --filter api-gateway test:e2e
